## Rules

- Recovery subject is the source fresh scope plus update window; an archive crawler may provide runtime settings but must not replace the subject filter. `array_pop` is legal only after a branch is proven drained or its replacement children are durably stored. Unsplittable cap is visible nonterminal/operator debt, never `Drained`. Unknown filter mapping fails closed through existing registry. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).

## Guidance

Add rollback regressions where archive has `stageCompleted=true` and fresh does not, and where OKPD/price differ; assert generated request keeps fresh subject fields. Dense min interval/max-block test must resume from durable stack and eventually consume an injected later row. Do not hardcode fz44 filter arrays outside the typed DTO/registry. If `RecoveryScope` cannot be serialized in cursor without breaking compatibility, add a new D# before changing schema.
